verdict.rationale: Namecheap open-sources auxiliary SDKs and a Terraform provider (go-namecheap-sdk, terraform-provider-namecheap) under presumably open licenses, but there is no evidence that the core Namecheap platform/service source code itself is published under an open license — only client integration tooling is open. Missing for 10: license text for SDK repos, confirmation that the actual registrar/service platform code is open-sourced, and any statement of an open-source policy for the core product.
